key_insight: Lineage context helps generative models recover developmental dynamics that gene expression alone does not resolve.
engineering_relevance: The approach illustrates how relational context can improve dynamical modeling and support counterfactual simulation in structured biological systems.
method: Represent cell states and their lineage relationships.
Combine tree-structured transformers with stochastic interpolants for lineage inpainting.
Simulate counterfactual perturbations using a model trained on unperturbed development.
evidence_signal: On a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, the model recovered multiple transcriptional convergence events and generated perturbation hypotheses consistent with many observed phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response.
watch_item: Counterfactual predictions remain hypotheses: agreement with selected phenotypes does not establish accuracy across unseen perturbations.
paper_title: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
